verdict.rationale: Better Auth hosts its own remote MCP server that gives MCP-capable AI clients (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) documentation search, examples, and setup help. That offers a glancing, first-party natural-language path for setting up the framework, but nothing shows natural-language commands actually operating it, such as managing users, sessions, or configuration. The MCP plugin (an OAuth server for your app's MCP clients) and llms.txt are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of the product beyond docs and setup help, any NL-driven admin or config actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
